text: 高盛周五表示，如果美国禁止柴油出口，拉丁美洲将是受影响最严重的地区。报告表示，厄瓜多尔、智利、墨西哥和秘鲁从美国进口的柴油占各自柴油消费量的50%以上。如果美国柴油供应突然中断，可能导致拉丁美洲GDP下降约1%，不过库存缓冲以及世界其他地区增加出口将减轻这一影响。高盛补充称：“鉴于柴油市场具有全球性，供应可能会迅速调整，因此实际上对全球经济的主要影响将来自柴油价格上涨。”高盛估计，美国每实施一周柴油出口禁令，美国零售柴油价格将下降每加仑0.25美元，实施一个月后，美国整体通胀率将受到温和拖累，降幅约为2-3个基点。
text_en: Goldman Sachs said on Friday that if the United States bans diesel exports, Latin America would be the most severely affected region. The report said Ecuador, Chile, Mexico and Peru import more than 50% of their diesel consumption from the United States. A sudden disruption in US diesel supply could cause Latin American GDP to fall by about 1%, although inventory buffers and increased exports from other parts of the world would mitigate this impact. Goldman Sachs added: "Given that the diesel market is global, supply may adjust quickly, so in practice the main impact on the global economy would come from higher diesel prices." Goldman Sachs estimates that for every week a US diesel export ban is implemented, US retail diesel prices would fall by $0.25 per gallon, and after one month of implementation, overall US inflation would be mildly dragged down by about 2-3 basis points.
